svg.aria-label: How a code change reaches the cluster
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: How a change reaches the cluster
pull request -> CI -> merge -> ECR -> GitOps repo -> Argo CD -> rolling update
CI commits the new image tag
pods move to the new image
The pipeline never talks to the cluster. Argo CD, running inside it, pulls from Git,
so no cluster credential ever lives in GitHub.
